scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:examples
scripts.dev:example:file-routing: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-remote build && pnpm --filter './examples/file-routing/**' --parallel dev
scripts.dev:example:file-routing:physical: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-remote build && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing dev
scripts.dev:example:file-routing:virtual: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-remote build && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing-virtual dev
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:remotes && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build:examples
scripts.dev:example:solid: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-solid-remote build && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-solid-host dev
scripts.dev:example:vue: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-vue-remote build && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-vue-host dev
scripts.dev:example:cross-framework: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-cross-solid-remote --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-cross-vue-remote build && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-cross-framework dev
